description: Hooks for the oracle plugin. SessionStart injects the verification protocol. PreToolUse on Bash intercepts unpinned install commands. PreToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit warns when the target path has not been Read recently (transcript-corpus evidence: ~1,100 'File has not been read yet' / 'File has been modified since read' / 'String to replace not found' errors). PostToolUse on Read records the path into a per-session state file so the guard above can consult it. PreToolUse + PostToolUse on the plugin-scoped firecrawl MCP tools enforce budget-aware gating: tiered soft-remind / ask / deny based on monthly + rolling-hour + single-call thresholds, with state persisted at ~/.claude/plugins/oracle/usage.json.
